title: Impressive

inlines.v: IMPRESS'IVE, adjective Making or tending to make an impression; having the power of affecting, or of exciting attention and feeling; adapted to touch sensibility or the conscience; as an impressive discourse; an impressive scene. 1. Capable of being impressed; susceptible.
